description: The telemetry_router spec lists 200/400/401/409/500 on GET /telemetry-routers/{telemetryRouterId}, without 404, although every sibling operation on the same path (PUT, PATCH, DELETE) documents it. STACKIT's own Go SDK waits for a deleted router by that 404 (stackitcloud/stackit-sdk-go, services/telemetryrouter/v1api/wait/wait.go, DeleteTelemetryRouterWaitHandler, read 2026-11-01), so the wire answers it. Without the tag a gone router surfaces as UnknownStackitError and can't be told from a failed read. No live probe: no credentials exist for this account.
